profile.headline: Software Engineer and Scientist at Rincon Research Corporation. B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Arizona.
profile.summary: I graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science, and a minor in Spanish and Statistics/Data Science from the University of Arizona in May 2023.

positions.title: Technical Consultant - Office of Student Computing Resources
positions.description:
Created training materials for certain software on OSCR technology such as SolidWorks, Visual Studio, Microsoft Office, etc. 
Mentor computer lab clients on how to use the software available to the, and assist with troubleshooting software and hardware.

organizations.name: Wildcat Fencing
organizations.description: Wildcat Fencing is the club epee fencing club at the University of Arizona. As president, I managed club operations, grew club membership, and managed the club budget in order to make a friendly environment dedicated to developing excellent epee fencers.

organizations.name: Blue Chip Leadership
organizations.description:
Participate in leadership training and volunteer activities on campus to
learn leadership principles. Finalist in 2021 Design Thinking Challenge, focused on improving health-
care for youth with disabilities at El Rio Community Health Center.
